decision.summary: Immutable ecology release packaging and exact inventory verification only; no runtime deployment
alternatives: Retain simulated counters without claiming operational credit
Wire tested backend execution with bounded supervision
counterevidence: Existing living swarm and capability port supply partial infrastructure, but several branches only count or probe.
assumptions: User authorizes implementation, bounded delegated coding and autonomous runtime operation; external paid inference is not authorized.
decision.forecast: Observed dispatch receipts and restart tests will distinguish executing services from declared capability masks.
decision.falsifier: An unavailable backend reports engaged, a timeout blocks heartbeats, or a disabled capability performs work.
acceptance: Scoped regressions reproduce and resolve identified defects
Real backend results, mask gates and bounded negative cases are observed
Autonomous heartbeat, failure isolation and recovery observed
Formal models and runtime receipts report their actual scope
Hooks load in the installed runtime
decision.rollback: Preserve prior scoped files and versioned running release; restore only owned source/artifact on failed verification.
decision.reviewer: Codex implementer plus bounded independent feature review; no implied system admission.
decision.budget: At most 3 delegated Codex workers, 4 BEAM schedulers per check, local tools only by default; OpenRouter free-only, max 512 completion tokens/request, no paid fallback; no unbounded solver or model invocation.
residuals: Whole-system admission remains NOT_ADMITTED until independent revision-bound evidence; source tests cannot certify all runtime services.

stpa_analysis.control_action: Dispatch a capability or advance an authorized evolutionary task

ucas.constraint: Check safety class and inherited prerequisite urgency before score.

ucas.context: A high score is mistaken for release authorization.
ucas.constraint: Authorization and effect constraints precede ranking.

ucas.context: Selection relies on a stale candidate or unfinished dependency.
ucas.constraint: Re-observe and reject affected stale/blocked selection.

ucas.context: An old worker keeps acting beyond its lease or budget.
ucas.constraint: Recheck current owner, fencing, expiry and budget before effects.

fmea_modes.cause: Capability declaration, counters and actual backend outcomes are not bound end to end.
fmea_modes.effect: False capability success or stalled/unsupervised cognition.
fmea_modes.controls: Typed outcomes, fresh source hashes, bounded execution, actual runtime tests, exact Sa-plan claims and reversible staged release.

criticality.rationale: Requested autonomous runtime needs working capability boundaries before activation.

stpa.rationale: Counters and backend-presence probes can misrepresent execution; current code must be observed and repaired.

dependency.rationale: Real capability execution and bounded workers are prerequisites of the requested continuous ecology.

impact.rationale: One shared ecology runtime serves the requested participating holons.
